The '''destruction''' of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Paran]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]] was a military operation conducted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After protests encouraged by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Wuxod (senator)|Wuxod]], the Empire dispatched a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to Derilyn. They conducted an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the city, levelling it completing and killing over 500,000 people. After the destruction, a resistance group known as the [[Friends of Paran]] was established.<ref name="PotGVT" />
